rule_title: TTP 1021.003 - DCOM Lateral Movement - MMC20 Remote Process Spawn
description: Detects lateral movement via the MMC20.Application DCOM object, which allows remote code execution by activating mmc.exe on a target host. The pattern is a network logon (LogonType 3) from a remote IP followed immediately by mmc.exe spawning with the -Embedding flag as a child of svchost.exe (the DCOM Server Process Launcher). The -Embedding argument is exclusive to DCOM activation and is never present in interactive or scripted MMC use.

steps.description: mmc.exe spawned with -Embedding by svchost.exe — definitive DCOM activation signature
